user.title: Connect printer
user.description: Enter the address of your network printer, preferably its **IP address** (e.g. 192.168.1.20 – names ending in ".local" often do not resolve in Home Assistant). Give the printer a fixed address in your router. The printer must support IPP (most network printers do).

data_description.printer_url: IP address or ipp://… address, e.g. ipp://192.168.1.20:631/ipp/print

error.cannot_connect: The printer does not respond. Check the address and that it is switched on and on the same network.

init.title: Webhook address for printing

data.regenerate: Generate a new address (the old one stops working)

data_description.notify_target: Optional: device/person to notify on success, missing paper etc. (e.g. “Florian's phone”). Leave empty for no push notification – problems will still show up as a Home Assistant notification.
data_description.notify_by_name:
One line per person, e.g.:
Florian: notify.mobile_app_iphone_von_florian
Deborah: notify.mobile_app_iphone_von_deborah

The name comes from the shortcut (“name=” in the address). If none matches, “Send push notification to” above is used instead, if set.
